rationale: Three unresolved design questions - dataset source, rewrite-vs-diff upgrade architecture, and whether design-system slices go into every-generation prompts or kit-authoring-only - materially change the implementation scope; changes to design prompts affect every future generation globally, and a bad rule would degrade output across all kits.

signals.blast_radius: New design-system data module, brand-kit assistant extensions, kit prompt authoring UI changes, and modifications to prompt builders in design paths (estimated 15-25 files); prompt injection may touch every generation flow.
signals.unresolved: Where does curated dataset come from (licensing/authoring approach); rewrite-vs-diff architecture for upgrade assistant (affects implementation complexity and reviewability); and hot-path inclusion (every-generation context vs kit-authoring-only, affects prompt size and scope).
signals.irreversibility: Kit-prompt upgrades via existing versioned BrandKitPrompt flow are revertible; PROMPT_VERSION stamps each draft so old renders stay tied to their prompt revision, but prompt context changes at new-generation default are persistent until explicitly reverted.
